scope: Actual rigid-tool/gripper controls in each backend; no material advance, cutting success, camera acceptance or complete physics promotion

transfer.orientation: Preserve measured initial edge orientation; nominal mount used only for IK
transfer.waypoints: Lift at initial XY to at least target Z, then translate to target XY
transfer.joint_profile: Quintic smoothstep, using measured starting joints and bounded actuator targets only

nominal_load.expectation: Stable finite grasp; actual contact and arm response compared with baseline

edge_torque.expectation: Finite measured response to a known edge torque

stress_load.expectation: Finite measured response; holding or slipping is reported, dropping is not required

weak_grip.expectation: Larger physical slip/rotation response than the matched strong grip

low_friction.expectation: Larger physical slip/rotation response than the matched normal-friction grip

release.expectation: Independent downward tool motion and an actual unsupported gravity interval

historical_reaction_scale.quantity: Maximum norm of actual next_material_wrench_world[:3]; old fixed-tool runs only, not a physical-grasp outcome
historical_reaction_scale.nominal_load_selection: 1 N exceeds the measured 0.28-0.71 N examples while remaining near their engineering load scale

evidence_boundaries: Each case uses a fresh normal pregrasp and the same finite transfer controller before its perturbation
Only actuator targets and actual body wrenches are written; no tool pose correction or hidden attachment
Tool and contact traces are privileged debug and never policy observations
Failure to initialize or transfer is preserved as failure, never replaced by a welded tool
Material feedback ON/OFF must be established by separate actual material episodes; external load is not relabelled material coupling
Held versus dropped stress behavior is measured without changing these criteria after results
changes_from_v1: Initialize fingers at 11.2 mm according to the separately frozen physical_grasp_initialization_v2 candidate; no dynamic tool pose correction
Use explicitly recorded actual PRE-step Native contact geometry, with unchanged 1 micrometre handle-region tolerance, and require exact agreement with the before-step pose and 2 ms timing
All task, stability, penetration, matched-start and response thresholds are inherited unchanged; original v1 results remain preserved
changes_from_parent: Ruler profile with true pad-derived blunt material obstacles and finger-body reaction routing
All control, matched-start, load, release and classification thresholds inherited unchanged
